eat.en: We should eat a variety of foods every day.
eat.cn: 我们每天应当吃多种食物。

healthy.en: A healthy lifestyle includes good food and exercise.
healthy.cn: 健康的生活方式包括好食物和运动。

vegetable.en: Green vegetables are full of vitamins and minerals.
vegetable.cn: 绿色蔬菜富含维生素和矿物质。

junk food.en: Too much junk food makes us feel tired and weak.
junk food.cn: 垃圾食品吃太多让人疲惫无力。

vitamin.en: Oranges and lemons are rich in vitamin C.
vitamin.cn: 橘子和柠檬富含维生素 C。

fat.en: Try to avoid food with too much sugar and fat.
fat.cn: 尽量少吃糖和脂肪太多的食物。

energy.en: Whole grains give us long-lasting energy.
energy.cn: 全谷物给我们持久的能量。

balance.en: Balance work, rest and play to stay happy.
balance.cn: 平衡工作、休息和娱乐才能开心。
